verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only documents card creation (POST /cards) with shipping/product parameters; there is no documented evidence of API endpoints or docs for activating, pausing/unpausing, reporting lost/stolen, reissuing with a linked replacement, or permanently closing a card. Missing for 10: activate/pause/unpause API docs, lost/stolen reporting endpoint, reissue-with-linked-replacement flow, permanent closure endpoint, any lifecycle state-transition documentation.
